name: pnp-powerplatform-snippets-brick-loading-animation
title: Brick Loading Animation
shortDescription: A customizable timer-free brick loading animation for Power Apps canvas apps, with colored bricks and editable loading messages.
longDescription: A customizable timer-free brick loading animation using inline SVG in a native Power Apps Image control. Colored bricks assemble above editable labels in a full-parent loading overlay, with no Timer, JavaScript, external assets, or connectors. The animation is indeterminate, and playback support varies by browser and Power Apps player.
